Looking at this problem, I need to prove:

```dafny
ensures K.Safe(K.Encode(K.Abs(x), if y >= K.Abs(x) then y else K.Abs(x) + K.Abs(x) - y))
```

I have access to `End.Direct` which has signature:
```dafny
lemma Direct(x: int, y: int)
  requires x >= 0 && y >= x
  ensures K.Safe(K.Encode(x, y))
```

So I need to call `End.Direct` with appropriate arguments. Let me analyze:

- First argument to `Direct` needs to be `>= 0`: `K.Abs(x)` is always `>= 0` ✓
- Second argument needs to be `>= first argument`
- The encoded result should match the postcondition

Looking at the postcondition expression:
- First arg to Encode: `K.Abs(x)`
- Second arg to Encode: `if y >= K.Abs(x) then y else K.Abs(x) + K.Abs(x) - y`

Let me check if the second argument is always `>= K.Abs(x)`:

Case 1: `y >= K.Abs(x)` → second arg is `y` which is `>= K.Abs(x)` ✓

Case 2: `y < K.Abs(x)` → second arg is `K.Abs(x) + K.Abs(x) - y = 2*K.Abs(x) - y`
Since `y < K.Abs(x)`, we have `-y > -K.Abs(x)`, so `2*K.Abs(x) - y > 2*K.Abs(x) - K.Abs(x) = K.Abs(x)` ✓

So the second argument is always `>= K.Abs(x)`.

Therefore, I can call:
```dafny
End.Direct(K.Abs(x), if y >= K.Abs(x) then y else K.Abs(x) + K.Abs(x) - y);
```

This should establish the postcondition directly.

{
  "HelperA.dfy": "include \"Kernel.dfy\"\ninclude \"Stage1.dfy\"\ninclude \"Stage2.dfy\"\ninclude \"Stage3.dfy\"\nmodule HelperA {\n  import K = Kernel`Public\n  import End = Stage3`Shallow\n  lemma {:induction false} Prove(x: int, y: int)\n    ensures K.Safe(K.Encode(K.Abs(x), if y >= K.Abs(x) then y else K.Abs(x) + K.Abs(x) - y))\n  {\n    End.Direct(K.Abs(x), if y >= K.Abs(x) then y else K.Abs(x) + K.Abs(x) - y);\n  }\n}\n",
  "HelperB.dfy": "include \"Kernel.dfy\"\ninclude \"Stage1.dfy\"\ninclude \"Stage2.dfy\"\ninclude \"Stage3.dfy\"\nmodule HelperB {\n  import K = Kernel`Public\n  import End = Stage3`Shallow\n  lemma {:induction false} Prove(x: int, y: int)\n    ensures K.Safe(K.Encode(K.Abs(x), if y >= K.Abs(x) then y else K.Abs(x) + K.Abs(x) - y))\n  {\n    End.Direct(K.Abs(x), if y >= K.Abs(x) then y else K.Abs(x) + K.Abs(x) - y);\n  }\n}\n"
}
